 STILLWATER, OKLA (KOKH) — A Stillwater resident has been sentenced to life in federal prison for charges of aggravated sexual abuse and production, receipt, and possession of child pornography.
 Lee Grant Clark, age 79, was identified as a suspect in an FBI investigation in October of 2024.
 “Mr. Clark’s repeated and deplorable predatory conduct against multiple child victims dates back to the 1980s,” said U.S. Attorney Robert J. Troester. “He stole the innocence of children and caused unspeakable trauma they should never have had to endure. This sentence ensures that Clark will spend the rest of his life in federal prison and never again prey on a child in our community.”
 During the FBI investigation, it was learned that Clark had sexually abused two minors around 2004. Further investigation found that Clark had produced CSAM and at least eight victims of molestation by Clark were identified.
 “There is no place in society for the predatory and reprehensible actions of this defendant, who sexually abused and exploited two minors for the purpose of creating child sexual abuse material,” said FBI Oklahoma City Special Agent in Charge Doug Goodwater. “No sentence can undo the harm inflicted on the victims, but this sentence will remove a dangerous predator from our community. The FBI and our partners will continue to relentlessly pursue those who target children and ensure they are brought to justice.”
 On Dec. 16, 2025, Clark pleaded guilty to all charges and admitted to sexually exploiting two minors to produce CSAM and crossing state lines to abuse minors.
